notes.title: Hotfix September 24, 2024
notes.notes:
- Fixed an issue where one of the endings would not properly appear. Now your evil deeds will be properly rewarded, well done!
- Fixed a bug where your friendly conspirator friend wouldn't actually show up, causing one of the final bosses to appear twice. Now they actually stick to the plan.
- Fixed an issue where an Act 2 boss would scream like a banshee upon death, causing a time loop. You're not Bill Murray, I'm really sorry about this one.
- Fixed an issue with a UI bug during the Harkin fight, now that pesky bag will properly hide.

notes.title: Hotfix March 10, 2023
notes.notes: Fixed a "Reassurance" bug where Jake would not trust the party, creating an error.

notes.title: Hotfix February 11, 2023
notes.notes: Fixed a potentially large bug with a Captain Marlowe dialogue option that didn't want to go away, even after asking politely. Anyone impacted, please select a dialogue option in the affected menu and it will redirect you to the proper spot now, hiding the menu properly. However, it might also send you back in time if you've progressed. My humblest apologies!

notes.title: Happy Release Day!!
notes.notes:
At last, after years of work, our team is proud to announce the release of "Beneath Her Starry Sky!" I hope you can support our little project! We're currently running a sale for the first week, please enjoy!

I've also made a few tweaks to the UI, hopefully it looks a bit cleaner! Please let me know if you see any bugs, I'll work on them right away - thanks!

notes.title: We're Live!
notes.notes:
Hello all! I'm proud to announce a new visual novel coming within the next few weeks! [i]Beneath Her Starry Sky[/i] is a love letter to the RPGs of old, mixing in fantasy/adventure with a dash of comedy. The game is fairly casual and relaxed, though there are several options to make things even easier if you'd prefer to just experience the story without any stress.

Some other features include a fairly light combat system, a freetime mechanic where you can visit companions and friends to build stats, and a whole ton of gallery items to unlock! You can also customize some of your protagonist's background, and there will be some dialogue choices that impact characters' fates, story events, and even the ending!

Beta testing will be starting soon, too! Please support us and spread the word :)
